Factor \(\zeta(s)=(s-1)^{-1}g(s)\) near \(1\), with \(g\) holomorphic and nonvanishing. Then
\[
-\zeta'/\zeta-\frac1{s-1}=-g'/g
\]
is locally bounded. Separately, \(N(T)=O(T\log T)\), and \(\log T\ll\sqrt T\) for \(T\ge2\), giving \(N(T)=O(T^{3/2})\).
